PATTERN: When removing a settings option in Whisnap, keep the Rust enum variant but change #[default]
WHY: Existing users' settings.json files may contain the old value — removing the variant would cause deserialization failure; keeping it means old files deserialize cleanly then get migrated to new default on next save
EXAMPLE: ThemeMode — kept System/Light/Dark variants, moved #[default] from System to Dark
WHERE: src-tauri/src/features/settings/types.rs — #[default] attribute on enum variant
GOTCHA: Tests that check 'default' behavior need updating; tests that explicitly use the old default value (e.g. ThemeMode::System) can stay
